/bin/bash -lc "cat > candidate.lean <<'EOF'
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC "'^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  classical
  intro ϑ
  induction ϑ with
  | zero => exact fun h => (Nat.lt_irrefl 0 h).elim
  | succ n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      intro _ u hp
      simp_rw [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation] at hp
      rw [prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq] at hp
      simp only [Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hp
      have h := hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hp
      have hu : u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) := by
        funext i
        match i with
        | 0 => rfl
        | 1 => rfl
      simp only [jointProximityNat₂, Fin.isValue] at h
      rw [← hu] at h
      exact h
    | succ n =>
      intro _ u hp
      simp_rw [multilinearCombine_recursive_form (u := u)] at hp
      rw [prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun
        (P := multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close MC u e)] at hp
      have hR := prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε) u e hp
      apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (u := u) (e := e)
      apply h_interleaved_gaps (2 ''^ (n + 1)) Nat.one_le_two_pow
      refine lt_of_lt_of_le hR (Pr_le_Pr_of_implies (D := $ᵖ F) _ _ ?_)
      intro r hr
      exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor (MC := MC)
        (ih := ih (Nat.succ_pos _)) (u := u) ⟨r, hr⟩
EOF
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean'
